semantic_fragments.content: 16.6.1 Touch Current Measurements for ME System: Allowable TOUCH CURRENT in NORMAL CONDITION is 100 µA; Allowable TOUCH CURRENT in event of interruption of PROTECTIVE EARTH CONDUCTOR is 500 µA. These limits apply to touch current measured from or between parts of the ME SYSTEM within the PATIENT ENVIRONMENT.

SP - Additional or special tests conducted: Clause 15.4.3.2: Batteries connected with incorrect polarity — result: No operating, no hazard (Pass). Clause 15.4.3.5: Protective device and Two MEANS OF OPERATOR PROTECTION be provided — result: No hazard (Pass).

US National Differences Attachment 1 covers AAMI/ANSI ES60601-1 requirements. The device under test is internally powered and portable, making several rated voltage and classification requirements N/A. The device is not an X-Ray system, making X-Ray-specific NFPA 70 markings N/A. No medical gas cylinders are present, making NFPA 99 gas cylinder color requirements N/A.
END OF IEC 60601-1 TEST REPORT. The report continues with ATTACHMENT 1: US NATIONAL DIFFERENCES and ATTACHMENT 2: PHOTO DOCUMENTATION.
